close_reason: Updated reg! macro in jmap-calendars-server to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx; clippy clean
description:
Update register_calendars_handlers to forward CallerCtx using ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> (from JMAP-exue.1).

All CalendarEvent/*, Calendar/*, and Principal/getAvailability handler closures receive ctx: C. Particularly relevant for multi-tenant calendar servers where compute_utc_times and get_availability need to know which user is requesting.

Acceptance criteria:
- register_calendars_handlers closures receive CallerCtx
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server exits 0
- Clippy clean

Depends on JMAP-exue.1.
title: jmap-calendars-server: Forward CallerCtx in register_calendars_handlers
